environment: Local isolated SSH test gateway, one x86-64 Linux host. The actual amd64 Windows Go GUI launcher and bundled Windows CPython ran under Wine; a separate OpenSSH server passed the single allowed loopback destination through to an original Ubuntu Noble GNOME Shell. No WAN latency was emulated.
route: Win32 --desktop-forwarded-port PORT connects to 127.0.0.1:PORT, over SSH user and host certificates and a strict trusted host CA. GNOME pairing remains separate. No public port or provider HTTPS image polling.

checks.digest: SHA-256 of original BGRX and actual Win32 client area via BitBlt/GetDIBSection after ignoring the unused high byte.

timing: From injecting a physical key or mouse action in the isolated Windows display to observing the first different source-matching Win32 client-area sample. Includes scheduling, keyboard injection, cloud rendering, transport, local rendering and sample interval.
